name: matterhorn
description: Matterhorn standalone studio and local AI orchestration runtime.

scripts.compile: npm run compile:core && npm run compile:server
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace=core && npm run check --workspace=server && npm run test:studio && node core/out/test/flyrailAdapter.test.js
scripts.test:studio: node --test core/out/test/studioRun.test.js core/out/test/studioRunController.test.js core/out/test/flyrailEvidence.test.js core/out/test/flyrailTransport.test.js server/out/test/studioApi.test.js server/out/test/studioHistory.test.js server/out/test/workspace.test.js tests/web.test.mjs tests/workspace-web.test.mjs
